commit.message:
[size] Share the kind-independent half of building a subtable (#565)

Source::finish was instantiated for every subtable kind, with the coverage
cache allocation and the subtable's assembly copied into each. Only the
second-glyph digest, the cache cost and the conversion into a cached kind
depend on the kind, so the rest moves into two non-generic functions.
Budget charges happen in the same order as before.

opt-level z: 1,091,320 -> 1,086,920 bytes (-4.3 KiB)
